sonnet.problem: Card 4 and card 16 both use a junk-drawer joke in stop 1. His drawer years may carry a joke at most once per stop, and the same joke idea shouldn't repeat in a lesson.
sonnet.rule: His drawer years carry a joke at most once per stop.

sonnet.problem: The question says the girl's age is "a number that already came up earlier in this passage." That rules out the wrong answers (seven and ten) and points straight to twelve, so the question gives away its own answer.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
